faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Research Assistant position at IIT(ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the Research Assistant (RA) post at IIT(ISM) Dhanbad is 31 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a B.Tech/BE in Mechanical/Automobile/Industrial & Production/Manufacturing and an M.Tech degree. Alternatively, two years of experience in the Design/Manufacturing industry with knowledge of ANSYS/LS-Dyna software is also accepted.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Research Assistant (RA) position is 28 years. Age relaxation is applicable for SC/ST and OBC categories as per government norms.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month for the first year and Rs. 35,000/- per month for the second year.

faq.question: Q5. How can I apply for the Research Assistant position at IIT(ISM) Dhanbad?
faq.answer: Applications are to be submitted via email. You need to prepare your application with complete bio-data and attach self-attested copies of required documents, then send it to the official email address before the last date.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Research Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Research Assistant (RA) position will be based on an interview. Candidates shortlisted after the initial screening will be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the job type for this Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: The Research Assistant (RA) position at IIT(ISM) Dhanbad is a contractual job.

faq.question: Q9. Does IIT(ISM) Dhanbad offer any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: Yes, IIT(ISM) Dhanbad offers age relaxation for reserved categories. There is a relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST candidates and 3 years for OBC candidates.
